purpose: Executable construction components. Each record is the knowledge side of a function in femm_brain/components.py; layer-2 methods bind to existing documented method nodes where one exists.

components.title: Straight segment
components.description: A straight contour between two points, with optional mesh size and contour properties.

parameters.name: mesh
parameters.description: Maximum element size along the segment; omit for automatic

parameters.name: boundary
parameters.description: Boundary property attached to the contour

parameters.name: conductor
parameters.description: Conductor (scalar physics) attached to the contour

components.title: Polyline or polygon
components.description: Consecutive straight segments through points, optionally closed, with per-edge contour properties.

parameters.name: closed
parameters.description: Join the last vertex to the first

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: One entry per edge with boundary, conductor, mesh, hidden or group

parameters.name: boundary
parameters.description: Boundary property attached to the contour

parameters.name: conductor
parameters.description: Conductor (scalar physics) attached to the contour

components.title: Circular arc
components.description: A counterclockwise arc from start to end spanning the given angle, discretized at the given maximum segment angle.

parameters.name: boundary
parameters.description: Boundary property attached to the contour

parameters.name: conductor
parameters.description: Conductor (scalar physics) attached to the contour

components.title: Full circle
components.description: Two 180-degree arcs; contour properties may differ between the upper and lower halves.

parameters.name: upper
parameters.description: Contour properties for the upper half

parameters.name: lower
parameters.description: Contour properties for the lower half

parameters.name: boundary
parameters.description: Boundary property attached to the contour

parameters.name: conductor
parameters.description: Conductor (scalar physics) attached to the contour

components.title: Isolated node
components.description: A node not attached to any contour; the mesher keeps it as a vertex, so it shapes the local mesh.

components.title: Block label
components.description: Assigns a material and, for magnetics, a circuit, turns and magnetization direction to the enclosing region.

parameters.name: mesh
parameters.description: Maximum element size; omit for automatic

parameters.name: turns
parameters.description: Signed series turns; a nonzero integer, used only with a circuit

parameters.name: external
parameters.description: Member of a Kelvin external region

parameters.name: magdir_function
parameters.description: Magnetization direction as a FEMM expression of position, e.g. theta

components.title: Unmeshed region
components.description: A block label marked <No Mesh>, for example the interior of an air-gap element.

components.title: Material property
components.description: A material with explicit native property values (FEMM file keys) and an optional B-H or k(T) curve; curves must rise monotonically.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Native property values, e.g. Mu_x, Sigma, H_c, ex, Kx

components.title: Official library material
components.description: Copies a named entry exactly from FEMM's official material libraries (all 513 magnetic, electrostatic and heat-flow entries are bundled), including B-H or k(T) curves.

parameters.name: as_name
parameters.description: Name to give the copied entry in the model

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Library folder, when the name is ambiguous

constraints: The library must match the problem's physics; entries whose properties the model cannot represent are refused.
Ambiguous names need their folder.

components.title: Circuit property
components.description: A series or parallel circuit with a prescribed (possibly complex) total current.

components.title: Conductor property
components.description: A prescribed-voltage (or temperature) or prescribed-charge (or heat-flux) conductor for scalar physics.

parameters.name: charge
parameters.description: Prescribed total charge or heat flux

components.title: Boundary property
components.description: A boundary property with explicit native values (FEMM file keys).

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Native boundary values, e.g. BdryType, c0

components.title: Fixed-potential boundary
components.description: A Dirichlet boundary: prescribed vector potential, voltage or temperature.

components.title: Mixed (Robin) open boundary
components.description: An asymptotic open-space boundary; the coefficients are supplied by the citing assembly (e.g. c0 = 2*eps0/r in the electrostatics tutorial).
constraints: The coefficient formula depends on physics and geometry and must be cited by the assembly.

components.title: Convection boundary
components.description: Heat transfer to ambient air with a film coefficient.

components.title: Improvised asymptotic boundary (open boundary builder)
components.description: Nested shells whose permeabilities emulate unbounded space, built exactly as FEMM's open boundary builder.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius of the domain of interest

parameters.name: center_y
parameters.description: Center on the axis (axisymmetric) or vertical offset

constraints: Axisymmetric use requires no other geometry on the axis inside the domain radius.
Centered on the x = 0 axis.

components.title: Axisymmetric winding section
components.description: A rectangular winding cross-section in r-z with its circuit, signed turns and wire material.

parameters.name: turns
parameters.description: Signed turns; a nonzero integer, used only with a circuit

components.title: Planar bar magnet
components.description: A rectangular permanent magnet with linear recoil permeability, coercivity and magnetization direction.

components.title: Air-gap element (sliding band)
components.description: Concentric rotor and stator circles linked by an air-gap boundary; rotor position is set by the boundary's inner angle without remeshing.
constraints: Both circles are centered at the origin.

components.title: Kelvin exterior with uniform applied field
components.description: Unbounded planar space modeled by a second disk periodically linked to the domain edge, filled with coercivity 2B/mu0 to impose a uniform field.

parameters.name: field_direction
parameters.description: Magnetization direction of the exterior disk; the applied field points at the mirror angle about x

parameters.name: boundaries
parameters.description: Names of the two periodic boundaries

constraints: The applied field is uniform at the mirror angle of the exterior magnetization, -alpha, with magnitude mu0*Hc/2: FEMM's mesher orients each periodic chain with its region on the left and reverses the second chain (tangle.cpp, buildPbcTwinFromCDT), linking rim angle 180-phi to domain angle phi, so the rim current M sin(phi'-alpha) appears in the domain as M sin(phi+alpha).
Both halves of each circle must be drawn counterclockwise from (+R, 0); the prediction assumes this construction.

components.title: Assign a boundary to existing segments
components.description: Gives a defined boundary condition to segments already drawn, each picked by a point lying inside it, as FEMM selects segments. Used for periodic pairs and for boundaries on edges another component drew.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: One point inside each segment to assign

constraints: Each point must lie inside exactly one segment, not at an endpoint.
The boundary property must already be defined.

components.title: Fixed potential at a point
components.description: Holds the potential (vector potential, voltage or temperature) at one node, creating the node if needed; fixes the gauge of models bounded only by periodic and natural boundaries.
constraints: A magnetics point property here fixes A only; point currents are not set.

components.title: Magnet array along an axis
components.description: Rectangular magnet blocks laid end to end along x or y, each with its own magnetization direction: tubular armatures in axisymmetric problems (radial blocks at 0 or 180 degrees, axial at 90 or 270) and linear arrays in planar ones. Quasi-Halbach, Halbach and radial arrays are different segment lists.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Position of the first block's start along the axis

parameters.name: inner
parameters.description: Lower edge across the axis (inner radius of a tubular array)

parameters.name: segments
parameters.description: [length, direction] of each block, in order

parameters.name: axis
parameters.description: Axis the blocks are laid along

parameters.name: draw_ends
parameters.description: Draw the array's two end lines

constraints: Every block has a positive length and a finite direction.
An axisymmetric array along y lies at nonnegative radii.

components.title: Slotted stator with shoed teeth
components.description: Parallel-sided teeth with shoes repeated around the axis: slot-bottom arcs, tooth sides, shoe undersides and edges, tip arcs and optional slot-opening chords and slot dividers. Teeth point outward when the tip radius exceeds the slot-bottom radius (outer-rotor machines) and inward otherwise.

parameters.name: slot_bottom_radius
parameters.description: Radius where the slots end (yoke side)

parameters.name: tip_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the tooth-tip arcs (air-gap side)

parameters.name: tooth_width
parameters.description: Width of the parallel-sided tooth body

parameters.name: tip_arc_length
parameters.description: Arc length of each tooth tip along the tip radius

parameters.name: shoe_axial_distance
parameters.description: Distance from the axis, along the tooth axis, of the shoe underside

parameters.name: first_tooth_angle
parameters.description: Angle of the first tooth axis

parameters.name: close_slot_openings
parameters.description: Draw chords across the slot openings

parameters.name: slot_divider
parameters.description: Split each slot into two halves for double-layer windings

parameters.name: iron_material
parameters.description: Stator iron material; places one label in the first tooth

constraints: Tooth bodies are parallel-sided; the shoe corner lies on the radial line through the end of the tip arc.
Tips must not overlap (tip arc below the slot pitch) and the shoe must overhang the tooth body.
The bore or yoke circle and its boundary are separate components.

components.title: Stator with tabulated slot profiles
components.description: Slots of the profile papers tabulate, repeated around the axis: a parallel-sided opening of given width and height, an optional wedge tapering to the slot top width, straight sides from the top width to the bottom width over the slot height, and a flat or arc bottom, with optional opening chords and slot dividers. The teeth are what lies between the slots. Slots open toward the axis for inner-rotor machines and away from it for outer-rotor machines.

parameters.name: bore_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the tooth tips facing the air gap

parameters.name: opening_width
parameters.description: Slot opening width (chord at the bore)

parameters.name: opening_height
parameters.description: Slot opening height from the bore

parameters.name: slot_width_top
parameters.description: Slot width at the end nearest the air gap

parameters.name: slot_width_bottom
parameters.description: Slot width at the slot bottom

parameters.name: slot_height
parameters.description: Height of the straight-sided slot body

parameters.name: wedge_height
parameters.description: Height of the wedge between the opening and the slot body

parameters.name: rotor_side
parameters.description: Which side the rotor is on: inner or outer

parameters.name: slot_bottom
parameters.description: flat or arc (centred on the axis)

parameters.name: first_tooth_angle
parameters.description: Angle of tooth 0; slot k is centred half a pitch after tooth k

parameters.name: close_slot_openings
parameters.description: Draw the chord separating each opening from its slot body

parameters.name: slot_divider
parameters.description: Split each slot along its centreline (double layers)

parameters.name: bore_max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of the bore arcs

parameters.name: slot_bottom_max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of arc slot bottoms

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group of the stator contours and label

parameters.name: slot_opening_group
parameters.description: Group of the opening chords (default: the stator group)

parameters.name: iron_material
parameters.description: Material of the stator iron label placed in tooth 0

parameters.name: iron_mesh
parameters.description: Element size of the stator iron

constraints: Widths are chords across the slot centreline; 'top' is the end nearest the air gap.
The opening may not be wider than the slot top, and adjacent slots may not overlap at the bore, top or bottom.
The yoke circle and its boundary are separate components.

components.title: Multi-phase winding by the star of slots
components.description: Assigns each coil (tooth coils, single or double layer) or slot (distributed single layer) to a phase and polarity from its EMF phasor using half-open phase belts, then places labels with the phase circuit and signed turns. A positive coil carries +turns in the slot clockwise of its tooth.

parameters.name: phases
parameters.description: Odd number of phase circuit names

parameters.name: first_tooth_angle
parameters.description: Angle of the first tooth axis

parameters.name: layer_offset
parameters.description: Angle of each double-layer label from its slot centre (default a quarter pitch)

constraints: Refuses windings whose phases receive unequal numbers of coil sides, and even phase counts.
Double layers need slots divided by the stator's slot divider; single-layer tooth coils need an even slot count.
Phase circuits and their currents are defined separately.

components.title: Surface permanent-magnet rotor poles
components.description: Block (rectangular) or arc magnets with alternating radial or parallel magnetization around the axis, with an optional mesh size on the air-gap face, seat arcs that close the rotor core between arc magnets, and a rotor angle offset.

parameters.name: near_face_distance
parameters.description: Distance of a block magnet's inner face from the axis

parameters.name: air_gap_side
parameters.description: Which face meets the air gap: inner (outer rotor) or outer (inner rotor)

parameters.name: first_pole_polarity
parameters.description: outward or inward for the first pole

parameters.name: first_pole_angle
parameters.description: Angle of the first pole axis

parameters.name: air_gap_face_mesh
parameters.description: Element size along a block magnet's air-gap face

parameters.name: arc_max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of arc-magnet faces (sets the air-gap discretization of arc magnets)

parameters.name: seat_arcs
parameters.description: Draw the rotor core surface between arc magnets, on the face away from the air gap

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group of the rotor contours and labels

constraints: Adjacent magnets must not overlap.
Radially magnetized arc magnets use FEMM's position-dependent direction (theta).

components.title: Salient poles with optional coil blocks
components.description: Salient poles repeated around the axis, for stators (poles pointing toward the axis) and rotors (poles pointing away): each pole face is an arc of the pole arc on the tip radius, straight sides run to root corners of a given root width (parallel sides by default, tapered otherwise), and an arc centred on the axis or a straight chord joins neighbouring poles at the root radius. Optional coil blocks lie against both sides of every pole between two distances along the pole axis and reach a given width beyond the side; the sides are split at the coil corners so coil and pole share edges. Switched-reluctance stators and rotors and wound-field salient-pole rotors are built from it.

parameters.name: tip_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the pole faces at the air gap

parameters.name: root_radius
parameters.description: Radius at which the poles join the yoke or core

parameters.name: pole_arc
parameters.description: Angle spanned by each pole face

parameters.name: root_width
parameters.description: Chord width of each pole at its root (default: the face chord, so parallel sides)

parameters.name: root_shape
parameters.description: arc (centred on the axis) or flat (a chord) between neighbouring pole roots

parameters.name: first_pole_angle
parameters.description: Angle of the axis of pole 0

parameters.name: coil_start
parameters.description: Distance from the axis, along the pole axis, of the coil block end nearer the axis

parameters.name: coil_end
parameters.description: Distance from the axis, along the pole axis, of the coil block end farther from the axis

parameters.name: coil_width
parameters.description: How far each coil block reaches beyond the pole side, at right angles to the pole axis

parameters.name: tip_max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of the pole face arcs

parameters.name: root_max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of the root arcs

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group of the pole contours and label (a rotor's group is rotated between positions)

parameters.name: iron_material
parameters.description: Material of the iron label placed in pole 0

constraints: Pole faces and pole roots of neighbouring poles may not overlap, and the sides run from the face toward the root.
Coil blocks need a start, an end and a width; they lie strictly between the face and root corners, inside their half of the gap between poles, and clear of the pole-face circle and the root.
The yoke or shaft circle and its boundary are separate components; coil circuits and turns come from salient_pole_winding.

components.title: Coils on salient poles
components.description: Places the block labels of coils wound around salient poles: pole k belongs to phase k mod m, and a coil of positive polarity carries +turns on the clockwise side of its pole and -turns on the counterclockwise side. By default the polarity alternates between successive poles of each phase, so the opposite poles of a switched-reluctance phase, or neighbouring poles of a single-circuit field winding, are north and south; an explicit list gives one sign per pole instead.

parameters.name: phases
parameters.description: Circuit names in pole order; pole k belongs to phases[k mod m]

parameters.name: turns
parameters.description: Turns per coil (per coil side label)

parameters.name: label_axial
parameters.description: Distance of the labels from the axis along each pole axis

parameters.name: label_offset
parameters.description: Distance of the labels to either side of each pole axis

parameters.name: first_pole_angle
parameters.description: Angle of the axis of pole 0

parameters.name: polarities
parameters.description: One polarity (+1 or -1) per pole; default alternates between successive poles of each phase

parameters.name: mesh
parameters.description: Element size of the coil blocks

constraints: The pole count must be a multiple of the number of phases, and phase names must be distinct.
Each label must lie between its pole axis and the middle of the gap to the next pole; the coil outlines come from salient_poles.
Phase circuits and their currents are defined separately.

components.title: Slotless belt winding
components.description: An annulus divided into winding belts, each a block in a circuit with signed turns, with gaps of another material between them: exposed or air-gap windings of slotless machines and benchmark induction motors. The component draws the annulus arcs split at every belt edge, the radial edges once, and one label per region.

parameters.name: inner_radius
parameters.description: Inner radius of the winding annulus

parameters.name: outer_radius
parameters.description: Outer radius of the winding annulus

parameters.name: belts
parameters.description: Belts as [start degrees, end degrees, circuit, turns], counterclockwise from start to end; belts may not overlap

parameters.name: gap_material
parameters.description: Material of the regions between belts

parameters.name: max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of the annulus arcs

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group of the winding contours and labels

constraints: Belts span more than zero and less than 360 degrees and may not overlap.
The annulus circles are drawn by the component; do not draw circles at its radii as well.
Phase circuits and their currents are defined separately.

components.title: Contours from a drawing, as a polar array
components.description: Segments and arcs given as data, usually extracted from a vector drawing a paper supplies (femm_brain.dxf reads DXF), repeated around the axis: copy k is turned by first_angle + k * angle_step. Endpoints within a snap distance are merged, so copies join exactly and drawing noise cannot split a corner, and a contour shared by two copies is drawn once. Arcs in given radius bands can take their own discretization, finer near an air gap.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Items ['segment', x0, y0, x1, y1] or ['arc', x0, y0, x1, y1, angle], arcs counterclockwise and at most 180 degrees

parameters.name: snap
parameters.description: Distance within which endpoints are one point

parameters.name: max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of the arcs

parameters.name: max_segment_bands
parameters.description: Bands [r_min, r_max, max_segment]: arcs whose radius lies in a band take that angular discretization (degrees)

parameters.name: min_segment_length
parameters.description: No arc is cut into pieces shorter than this (small fillets would otherwise force tiny elements)

constraints: Arcs are counterclockwise and no wider than 180 degrees (femm_brain.dxf splits wider ones).
Labels, materials and boundaries are assigned by other components; the drawing gives contours only.

components.title: Sliding-band air gap across a sector
components.description: FEMM's sliding-band (air-gap element) boundary across a sector of a machine with periodic or antiperiodic ends: the band's two arcs inside the gap with the sliding-band boundary, the band's ends, the radial ends of the thin gap regions on either side with one (anti)periodic boundary pair each, an air label in each thin region and a hole in the unmeshed band. The rotor side turns through the band's inner angle (boundary property 10), so rotor positions need no remeshing.

parameters.name: rotor_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the rotor surface (drawn by another component, with nodes at the sector ends)

parameters.name: stator_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the stator bore (drawn by another component)

parameters.name: start_angle
parameters.description: Angle of the sector's first end

parameters.name: end_angle
parameters.description: Angle of the sector's second end

parameters.name: band_inner_radius
parameters.description: Inner radius of the sliding band

parameters.name: band_outer_radius
parameters.description: Outer radius of the sliding band

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the band's boundary; the end pairs are <name>_rotor_ends and <name>_stator_ends

parameters.name: antiperiodic
parameters.description: Antiperiodic (an odd number of poles in the sector) or periodic

parameters.name: max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of the band arcs

parameters.name: air_material
parameters.description: Material of the thin gap regions

parameters.name: mesh
parameters.description: Element size of the thin gap regions

parameters.name: rotor_group
parameters.description: Group of the rotor-side gap region and its ends

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group of the band and the stator-side gap region

constraints: rotor radius < band inner radius < band outer radius < stator radius; the sector spans at most 180 degrees.
The rotor surface and stator bore must have nodes at the sector ends; the rest of each sector end needs its own (anti)periodic pairs (segment_boundary).

components.title: Boundary on drawn arcs
components.description: Assigns a defined boundary to existing arcs, each picked by a point lying on it (for example A = 0 on the outer rim of a sector drawn from a vector file).

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: One point [x, y] on each arc

constraints: Each point must lie inside exactly one arc.

components.title: Annulus of material sectors
components.description: An annulus divided into angular sectors, each a block of its own material and magnetization (radial outward or inward through FEMM's direction function, a parallel direction, or none), with an optional gap material between sectors: closed magnet rings of magnetic gears and Halbach rotors, and modulation pole pieces or teeth separated by air. The component draws the annulus arcs split at every sector edge, the radial edges once, and one label per region.

parameters.name: sectors
parameters.description: Sectors as [start degrees, end degrees, material, magnetization], counterclockwise from start to end; magnetization is null, "outward", "inward" or a direction in degrees; sectors may not overlap

parameters.name: copies
parameters.description: How many times the sectors are repeated around the axis (one period given, a pole count as a parameter)

parameters.name: gap_material
parameters.description: Material between sectors, required when the sectors leave gaps

parameters.name: max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of the annulus arcs

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group of the ring's contours and labels

constraints: Sectors span more than zero and less than 360 degrees and may not overlap; sectors that leave gaps need a gap material.
The annulus circles are drawn by the component; do not draw circles at its radii as well.
Radial magnetization uses FEMM's theta and theta+180 direction functions, so it follows each element's angle.

components.title: Synchronous reluctance flux barriers
components.description: Flux barriers of a synchronous reluctance (or PM-assisted) rotor, each symmetric about its pole's q-axis: a middle section perpendicular to the q-axis and two legs to rounded ends near the rotor surface, set by position along the q-axis, middle length, width, end angle from the d-axis, end width (the leg tapers to it) and the tangential rib between the end and the rotor surface. One label per barrier.

parameters.name: barriers
parameters.description: Barriers as [p, length, width, end_angle, end_width]: distance from the axis along the q-axis to the middle section's near edge, the middle section's centre-line length, the width, the end point's angle from the d-axis in degrees and the end width; innermost first

parameters.name: rib
parameters.description: Tangential rib between each barrier end and the rotor surface

parameters.name: first_q_angle
parameters.description: Angle of the first pole's q-axis

parameters.name: poles
parameters.description: How many poles to draw from the first (all by default)

parameters.name: max_segment
parameters.description: Maximum angular segment of the rounded ends

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group of the barrier contours and labels (the rotor's)

constraints: Barriers lie outside one another (each p at least the previous p plus width), end inside their pole and keep their ends beyond their bends.
The rotor surface, core label and shaft are drawn separately; the rib must leave the barrier ends inside the rotor.
